# WeLovePDF — Free Browser-Based Local PDF Utilities

> WeLovePDF is a privacy-first web platform offering 60+ free online PDF utilities. All file processing (compression, merging, splitting, conversion, OCR, signing, encryption) is performed 100% locally inside the user's web browser using JavaScript and WebAssembly (PDF.js, pdf-lib). No document files are ever uploaded to any remote server or third-party storage.

## Core Features & Guarantees
- **Privacy Guarantee**: 100% local in-browser processing. Files never leave your device.
- **Cost**: 100% Free with zero registration or forced account signups.
- **File Limit**: Up to 200MB per batch for client-side processing.
- **Cross-Platform**: Works on mobile (Android/iOS) and desktop browsers (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge).

- Merge PDF: https://www.welovepdf.best/merge-pdf
- Split PDF: https://www.welovepdf.best/split-pdf

- PDF to Word: https://www.welovepdf.best/pdf-to-word

- PDF to JPG: https://www.welovepdf.best/pdf-to-jpg
- JPG to PDF: https://www.welovepdf.best/jpg-to-pdf
- Sign PDF: https://www.welovepdf.best/sign-pdf
- Protect PDF: https://www.welovepdf.best/protect-pdf
- Unlock PDF: https://www.welovepdf.best/unlock-pdf
- Rotate PDF: https://www.welovepdf.best/rotate-pdf
- Delete PDF Pages: https://www.welovepdf.best/delete-pages
